Karnataka Minister Pitches Bengaluru Tunnel Project to Entrepreneurs

Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has urged entrepreneurs to support the proposed Hebbal-Silk Board tunnel road project in Bengaluru. He emphasized the necessity of such infrastructure, questioning how the city could function without it. Shivakumar also encouraged women to break traditional roles and pursue leadership positions.
